Fully Renovated Gem in the Heart of New Canaan  Welcome to 171 Richmond Hill Road, a beautifully reimagined residence blending classic charm with modern elegance. Fully renovated in 2020 with over $550,000 in thoughtful updates, this 3-bedroom, 2.5-bath home offers 2,340 square feet of meticulously finished living space.  Step inside to discover a sun-filled interior featuring a seamless floor plan, hardwood floors, and refined finishes throughout. The spacious primary suite includes a luxurious ensuite bath and a generous walk-in closet, creating a serene and private retreat. Two additional bedrooms share a well-appointed full bath, and a stylish powder room serves guests with ease.  The main floor offers a warm and inviting living area complete with a wood-burning fireplace-perfect for cozy gatherings. Additional highlights include a partial basement ideal for storage or future expansion, central air conditioning for year-round comfort, and two oversized back-to-back garages offering rare flexibility for parking, a workshop, or extra storage.  Ideally located near town, parks, and top-rated schools, 171 Richmond Hill Rd combines high-end renovation with unbeatable convenience in one of New Canaan's most desirable neighborhoods.
